Description
University of Strathclyde is a leading public research university located in Glasgow, Scotland, founded in 1796 as the Andersonian Institute. It gained university status in 1964 and is renowned for its strong emphasis on innovation, industry engagement, and practical learning.
The university is especially well-regarded for its programs in engineering, business, science, and law, and it consistently ranks among the top UK universities for research and graduate employability. With a vibrant urban campus in the heart of Glasgow, Strathclyde hosts a diverse community of students from over 100 countries.
Its motto, “The Place of Useful Learning,” reflects its mission to apply knowledge for real-world impact.
